name: Creator Ownership Stack Engine

canonical.title: Creator Ownership Stack Mapper
canonical.job: Show what a creator or founder owns, rents, depends on, licenses or could lose across platforms and assets.
canonical.bWeb: Drag assets across OWN, RENT and DEPEND and watch exposure recalculate.

derived.controlSemantics: OWN, RENT, and DEPEND are operational relationship labels, not legal-title conclusions.
derived.scoreMeaning: Derived dependency-recovery index; not probability, value, contract interpretation, or legal risk.

nonClaims: The map does not determine legal title or intellectual-property ownership.
A selected control class cannot establish custody, license, or contractual rights.
The map does not establish asset value, portability, business continuity, or platform availability.
